schema.title: pack metadata

description:
Hi team,

I've put together a custom data pack that adds new biomes and structures to the world. The pack is described as “A custom data pack that adds new biomes and structures.” and targets pack format version 12, so it will work with the latest compatible Minecraft releases.

To keep the content organized, the pack includes filter rules for both biomes and structures. All biome files must reside in the namespace **^custom_biomes$** and can be located anywhere (path `.*`). Structure files are limited to the namespace **^custom_structures$** and must be stored under the `structures/` directory with an `.nbt` extension, matching the path pattern **^structures/.*\.nbt$**.

pack.description: A custom data pack that adds new biomes and structures.
